_about: Scoring rules for AI Economy -> Build-Out. These are STARTING POINTS to argue with, not truths. Edit and reload the page: server/aiBuildout.js reads this file on every request. Status values: moffett = leans funding-loop, productivity = leans productivity, neutral = neither. A null threshold means the signal is shown for context but not scored.

capexOcf._doc: Aggregate trailing-4-quarter capex / operating cash flow across the five hyperscalers.

debtIssuance._doc: Trailing-4-quarter long-term debt raised, % change on the trailing 4 quarters a year earlier.

qssVsCapex._doc: Census QSS NAICS 518 revenue growth minus hyperscaler capex growth (both trailing-4Q y/y), percentage points.

offBalanceSheet._doc: Count of logged off-balance-sheet / vendor-financing events in the last 12 months (manual-inputs.json). Null = unscored.

tfp._doc: SF Fed utilization-adjusted TFP: average annualized quarterly growth over the last `window` quarters vs the baseline period average.

laborProductivity._doc: BLS nonfarm business output per hour, same rule as TFP. Added to the original spec; delete the block to stop scoring it.

softwareOutputVsJobs._doc: Real software investment growth minus software employment growth (y/y), percentage points.
